description.describe_ch: 為加強學生執行研究與解決問題的能力，本課程將要求學生針對學術專業問題進行探討，並將研究過程和成果撰寫成研究論文。論文內容架構需包含導論、文獻回顧、方法、結果、結論和參考文獻。
description.describe_eh: For enhancing abilities in executing the research project and problem- solving, each student in this course will be assigned a project related to their own academic expertise, and also be asked to write a Master thesis to describe the procedures and contributions of his or her research work. The frame of this thesis must include the following major parts: introduction, reviews, methods, results, conclusions and references.

targets.describe_ch: 1.學生能透過相關數據資料的擷取蒐集和分析探討，並於碩士論文研究中，驗證、應用，並將研究結果撰寫於論文之中。
targets.describe_en: 1.Students can the searched related documents and/or data via the acquisition and analysis.They also can  verify, apply, and  compose the results of research in the Master thesis.

targets.describe_ch: 2.學生能在碩士論文中提出新穎的方法或觀念，並能獨立解決研究中的問題。
targets.describe_en: 2.Students can propose novel methods or concepts in the  Master thesis, and solve the problems by himself in research.

targets.describe_ch: 3.學生能團隊合作，參加研究群會議，並發表研討會論文。
targets.describe_en: 3. Students can be in collaboration with others, attend the group meeting and publish conference papers.

targets.describe_ch: 4.學生能瞭解並說明各項碩士論文研究之方法與進行程序，並能針對碩士論文研究內的特定主題，歸納出適切結論。
targets.describe_en: 4.Students can understand and describe various kinds of research methods and procedures applied in the Master thesis's work. Students also can sum up the appropriate conclusions about the specific topics in the Master thesis's study.

targets.describe_ch: 5.學生能閱讀國際最新期刊等論文內容，以掌握研究之發展現況，並能以書面及口頭方式發表研究相關結果。
targets.describe_en: 5.Students can know the development about the research by reading the latest international journal paper, and they also can give an oral and written report of his/her Master thesis's study.
